summary: Frontend-only testing of iPhone Settings simulator changes. All 6 requested scenarios verified against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Found and fixed 1 blocking navigation typo in Settings.js (row-general pointed to '/settings/general' which does not exist as a route and got redirected to '/' via the catch-all). After the fix, every flow works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: row-general navigated to non-existent route '/settings/general' causing fallback to '/' (Settings home). Fixed to '/general'.

critical_code_review_comments: Settings.js had hardcoded stale path '/settings/general' inconsistent with App.js routes; consider centralising route paths as constants to prevent regressions.
Phone.js call() logic silently clears input on any non-magic value; consider a subtle 'invalid' feedback UI (optional).
About.js labels SEID field but data key is 'seeid' (typo in schema key propagates across About/Admin/Phone). Not breaking, but worth renaming.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@iphone.local / admin123 (from request; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not consulted separately)
seed_data_creation: None. Admin IMEI was temporarily changed to 356789104532888 during verification and restored to 356789104532198 as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: '/' renders settings-home, row-general -> /general -> row-about -> /about with dynamic device data (about-imei shows 356789104532198). Dialer at /phone: typing *#06# via key-star,key-hash,key-0,key-6,key-hash opens imei-info-sheet with IMEI 356789104532198 and IMEI2 356789104532206. Negative case (12345) clears input without opening sheet. phone-backspace deletes last char. phone-exit returns to '/'. Admin login at /admin/login with admin@iphone.local/admin123 redirects to /admin; changing field-imei to 356789104532888 and saving reflects on /phone dialer *#06# result. IMEI restored back to 356789104532198.
rca of the issue: Settings.js used stale route string '/settings/general' from a prior IMEI-check design; App.js routes were flattened to '/general'. Because '*' route <Navigate to='/' /> is present, an unmatched click silently returned users to Settings home, making General/About unreachable from Settings. Reproduction: click row-general on '/'. Mitigation applied: change navigate('/settings/general') -> navigate('/general') in /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.js.
